Good to know

Policies

Clear policies help keep things fair and stress-free for everyone.

Booking & Payment

  • Book at least 48 hours in advance
  • Payment due at time of service
  • Accepted: Venmo?, Zelle?, Cash
  • New clients require submission of the Intake Form

Cancellations

  • Cancel 24hrs+ ahead: full refund
  • Cancel under 24hrs: 50% charge
  • Same-day cancellations: full charge
  • Emergencies handled case-by-case

Pet Requirements

  • Up-to-date vaccinations required
  • Flea & tick prevention must be current
  • All dogs will be on leash outdoors

Art Commissions

  • 50% deposit required to start
  • Turnaround: 1–3 weeks
